summary: @servicetitan/acquisition-functions ships a preinstall alternate-runtime dropper that executes an obfuscated Bun payload
details: The package publishes under the @servicetitan scope and its README presents it as a MongoDB Atlas Functions helper, but package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from a GitHub releases URL to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` on the installer's host at `npm install` time. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) heavily obfuscated with an obfuscator.io-style rotating string array, a large character-code token array, a custom decoder, and hex-only identifiers; setup.mjs itself is similarly obfuscated. Executing the payload under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-based static analysis. The stated MongoDB helper purpose does not require the Bun runtime, and the shipped dist/ library appears to serve as cover for the install-time payload. The scoped-package naming is consistent with impersonation of a ServiceTitan-internal package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
